versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the llm-testing skill.
- Provides curated prompts and wordlists for testing LLM security, safety, privacy, and bias.
- Includes test categories for bias detection, data leakage, privacy boundaries, memory recall, and alignment/adversarial resistance.
- Clear usage instructions, best practices, and ethical guidelines included.
- Structured file organization for easy integration and expansion.
- References to leading AI safety and red teaming frameworks.
